news.analysis: Maye continues a dynamic stretch behind center, recording three or more touchdowns in each of his last six contests. The quarterback will look to offer fantasy managers another impactful option against a shaky Detroit Lions defense in Week 10.

news.analysis: Dobbins has lost considerable ground to Jonah Coleman over the last three games. The latter had 21 touches for 88 yards and a touchdown Sunday. Dobbins, meanwhile, hasn't scored since Week 7. The Broncos have shifted their backfield toward Coleman, leaving Dobbins difficult to trust as a fantasy starter.

news.title: J.K. Dobbins struggles again in Week 9

news.contents: Denver Broncos head coach Sean Payton did not discuss the team's running back rotation following a 26-21 Week 9 win against the Carolina Panthers. Payton started rookie back Jonah Coleman in Week 9 over veteran J.K. Dobbins, and the Washington product led the ground game with 17 carries for 57 yards and his second touchdown of the season. news.analysis: Black led San Francisco in rushing despite seeing seven fewer carries than Christian McCaffrey. He did not see a target in the passing game. He remains a touchdown dependent flex play moving forward.
news.contents: Kaelon Black ran for 70 yards on 11 carries in the 49ers 38-17 win over the Raiders.

news.analysis: Shrader was perfect in the close loss. He hit field goals from 47, 59, and 50 yards out for the Colts. The veteran kicker now has 22 field goals in 24 tries, including eight from at least 50 yards away. He will take on the Dolphins in Week 10.

news.contents: Indianapolis Colts kicker Spencer Shrader is hopeful for more action after not making much of an impact last weekend. Shrader made his lone extra point attempt and didn't attempt a field goal during the Week 8 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars. In Week 7, Shrader missed two field goals in the defeat to the Minnesota Vikings. Fantasy managers can be hopeful for a rebound performance against the Dallas Cowboys in Week 9. The Cowboys rank 29th in the league when it comes to kicker points allowed. ...

news.title: Bam Knight (concussion) ruled out Sunday

news.contents: Arizona Cardinals running back Bam Knight (concussion) has been ruled out for the team's Week 9 divisional matchup with the Seahawks, according to ESPN's Josh Weinfuss. With teammate Jeremiyah Love (ankle) sidelined with a high-ankle sprain, Knight came into Week 8 as a popular sleeper play, but was knocked out of the team's upset victory over the Cowboys with a second-quarter concussion, opening the door for Tyler Allgeier to rack up a season-high 191 yards from scrimmage and two touchdowns. ...
news.title: Bam Knight Ruled Out for Week 9
